normalized_decision: emitMetricsGitHub emits ::error annotations for every SDP violation and every bounded-context violation present in the report. Separately, runMetrics uses --fail-on-violation to decide whether SDP/context violations change the process exit code. Therefore, when --fail-on-violation=false, SDP/context findings can still be rendered as ::error annotations even though they do not cause exit code 1. The instability path is different: OverInstable contains findings only when the max-instability gate is enabled and exceeded.
authority_evidence: emitMetricsGitHub (L353-360) emits ::error for SDP/context unconditionally; runMetrics (L261-L274) gates exit code on --fail-on-violation; flag default true at L214; instability path correctly gated by MaxInstability via overInstable (metrics.go L203-L216)
candidate_rule: emitMetricsGitHub: unconditional ::error for SDP/context; runMetrics: exit 1 gated by --fail-on-violation; instability gated by MaxInstability
